sentences.en: He had led the Republican Party with great success.
sentences.zh: 他在共和党内部取得了巨大成功。

sentences.en: Many Republicans did not vote for their own candidate.
sentences.zh: 许多共和党人没有为他们自己的候选人投票。

sentences.en: The Democrats blamed the Republicans, and the Republicans blamed the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 民主党指责共和党，而共和党反过来指责民主党。

senses.zh: 共和党人；共和政体支持者
